body: Selling my ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 9 in good working condition. Battery health 84 percent, keyboard and screen fully functional, small scratch on the lid corner (see photos). Comes with the original charger and box. Happy to meet in person around Sudirman or Kemang for inspection and testing before you pay, cash on delivery or bank transfer at the meetup is fine. Price is firm but fair, no trades please. Available on weekends, send a message through the platform to arrange a time.
title: Used ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 9, i7 / 16GB / 512GB, Jakarta
